basic_details.job_title: Andhra University Field Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: One temporary Field Assistant position is open in the NRSC sponsored research project "Coastal Observation Research Laboratory (NICES-CORAL)" at the Center for Studies on Bay of Bengal, Andhra University, Visakhapatnam. The project runs for two years, and the pay is Rs.20,000/- per month consolidated. BSc degree holders with Physics may apply. Applicants send their bio-data and certificate copies to the Director of the Centre, with the email [email protected] given, within ten days of the advertisement dated 6 November 2026. That works out to about 16 November 2026 (10 days from 6 November 202

important_dates.last_date_to_apply: Within ten days of advertisement (about 16 November 2026)
important_dates.interview_date: To be intimated through e-mail or phone

how_to_apply: The notice does not prescribe an application form. Interested candidates send their bio-data with copies of their certificates to the Director of the Centre within ten days of the advertisement dated 6 November 2026. That is about 16 November 2026, counted as 10 days from 6 November 2026. The notice says "receipt of applications", so the application should reach the Centre within this period.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: BSc degree holders with Physics may also apply. If suitable candidates with the above qualifications are not found, candidates with relevant field and lab experience can be considered with relaxed qualifications. The notice does not mention an age limit. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility for the Field Assistant post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The position is a temporary project position. The project duration is two years.

content_sections.heading: Andhra University Field Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice describes the nature of work as follows: Extensive marine cruise along the coastal regions will form an integral part. Real time data analysis needs to be carried out. Carrying out of onboard data collection, analysis, Oceanographic data etc. Data quality checks and archival of data. Look after all other project activities.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be called for an interview. The date and place of the interview will be intimated through e-mail or phone. No TA and DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the Andhra University Field Assistant recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 Field Assistant vacancy in the NRSC sponsored NICES-CORAL project at the Center for Studies on Bay of Bengal, Andhra University.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Andhra University Field Assistant post?
faq.answer: Applications must be received within ten days of the advertisement dated 6 November 2026, which is about 16 November 2026 (10 days from 6 November 2026).

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Field Assistant post?
faq.answer: BSc degree holders with Physics may apply. If suitable candidates are not found, candidates with relevant field and lab experience can be considered with relaxed qualifications.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the Andhra University Field Assistant?
faq.answer: The notice prints Rs.20,000/- per month consolidated.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the Andhra University Field Assistant post?
faq.answer: Send your bio-data with photo copies of the qualifying degree, marks lists and experience certificates to The Director, Centre for Studies on Bay of Bengal, Andhra University, Visakhapatnam – 530 003 (email: [email protected]), clearly specifying the position.

faq.question: Q6. How will the Field Assistant be selected?
faq.answer: Candidates will be called for an interview, and the date and place will be intimated through e-mail or phone.

faq.question: Q7. Is TA or DA paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA and DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is the Andhra University Field Assistant job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a temporary project position in an NRSC sponsored research project with a project duration of two years.

faq.question: Q9. What work does the Field Assistant do?
faq.answer: The work includes extensive marine cruises along the coastal regions, real time data analysis, onboard data collection, oceanographic data analysis, data quality checks, archival of data and other project activities.
